Ziggs

the Hexplosives Expert
Mid laneBot lane

Ziggs is a bomb-throwing yordle who loves blowing up turrets. He pokes from long range, knocks himself and enemies around with his satchel, and his ultimate can hit almost anywhere on your screen. He's played in mid lane and in bot lane as a mage carry, and few champions take towers faster.

When to pick Ziggs

✓ Safe blind pick

Mostly. Long range and fast wave clear make his lane safe mid or bot, but assassins can still reach him.

Pick into

  • Slow, defensive teams: he takes towers quickly with Satchel Charge and poke
  • Immobile champions he can poke from far away, like Galio and short-range melee mids
  • Low-range bot lanes he out-pokes and out-pushes
  • Teams with weak wave clear that can't stop his siege

Avoid into

  • Assassins and divers who reach him, like Katarina, LeBlanc and Irelia
  • All-in bot lanes with hard engage, like a Draven + Leona
  • Teams that want short, close-range fights where poke matters less

Great teammates

LuxA Lux support adds even more long-range poke for a siege composition.
KarmaKarma's shields and speed help Ziggs poke safely.
JayceJayce adds long-range poke to a siege team (in flex picks).

Your team needs: Pick Ziggs when your team wants to poke and siege towers, and has some peel to keep divers off him.

How to read the enemy team → · Practice drafting →

Strengths

  • Satchel Charge can instantly destroy low-health turrets
  • Long-range poke and very fast wave clear
  • Mega Inferno Bomb has enormous range
  • Easy to learn

Weaknesses

  • Satchel Charge is his only escape
  • Weak against assassins and divers
  • His damage is mostly poke, not instant burst
  • Weaker in long, close-range fights

Power spikes

  • Level 2: Q + auto pokes well.
  • Level 6: Mega Inferno Bomb lets you finish kills from anywhere on your screen.
  • First item (Luden's Echo): stronger poke and wave clear.
  • Three items (Rabadon's Deathcap): your Q and ultimate deal huge damage.

Top tips

  • Use W to destroy low-health turrets instantly.
  • Poke with Q from long range and aim where the enemy is walking.
  • Throw E between you and a diver to slow them.
  • Your ultimate has huge range: use it to help other lanes.
  • In bot lane, focus on taking towers early with your support.
  • Throw W at your feet and recast to escape, even over walls.
